_note: A NEW STEP ACTION EXISTS BECAUSE OF THIS BOARD. `contextmenu` was not in
the recipe vocabulary, so a right-click state could only be reached by
faking it from a fixture — which measures the fixture, not the menu the
product opens. measure.mjs now issues a real right-click and lib.mjs's
STEP_ACTIONS admits it. Three boards in this family draw a context menu.
THE STATE IS REACHED THE WAY A USER REACHES IT: click the Unused smart
folder, wait for the scope note that only that folder produces, then
right-click one of the three cards it left. `smartFolder` and `ctxMenu`
are both internal state and neither is a prop. The fixture's usage answers
make exactly three of ten assets unused, so the note's arithmetic is the
product's own rather than a number typed into a probe.
BOARD WON:
1163:13931  the menu is bg-elevated on a --color/border edge with a 6
top/bottom pad. It had NO border at all, so its only
separation from what it covers was a shadow.
1163:13932  the rows HUG on a 12/7 pad and are 11px in --color/ink-soft;
they shipped on a fixed --bk-size-row-dense height at 12px
in full ink. The fixed height is why the board's 7 had never
applied — a height and a padding do not conflict, so nothing
won. Fourth surface in this batch with that same cause.
1163:13929  the unused-scope note is 12/6 at 10px and sits in the grid
column's own rhythm; it carried a 20-side margin of its own.
MENU WIDTH IS 182, NOT 180, AND THAT IS DELIBERATE. 1163:13932 gives each
ROW w-180 and 1163:13931 gives the surface a stroke. Figma strokes do not
consume layout and a CSS border does, so a 180 box with a 1px edge leaves
178 inside it. The board's number is the row's; the box is the row plus
its edge.
NOT JOINED: 1163:13947, the details rail's 'Select an asset to see
details.' — the board names --color/ink-placeholder, which is 2.5:1 on
white and fails AA; it shipped at --bk-ink-disabled, which is 1.47:1 and
fails harder. Neither is right, and the code is now --bk-ink-soft. The
chassis (rail, toolbar, status, columns) is measured on
media-fullpage-library and is not re-joined here, so one fix cannot report
itself five times.
CONTRAST — one failure, the same `.mgr-kind` file-kind badge recorded on
media-fullpage-library: white on --color/bg-overlay (1161:66 / 1163:13834)
over the fixture's light grey placeholder thumb, 3.99:1. The ratio is a
function of the picture behind the scrim, and fixing it means a scrim
darker than the token the board names.
